target_year_over_year_context.explanation: Both disclosures identify Intel's primary competitors in the foundry/market space as Asian-based pure-play foundries (TSMC, Samsung) and describe the competitive landscape. comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm expects transitions to new generations of leading process technology nodes to continue driving product cost increases from key semiconductor wafer suppliers.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Qualcomm disclose that transitions to new generations of advanced semiconductor process technology are driving up costs from wafer suppliers. Intel explicitly identifies TSMC and Samsung as competitors in the 'advanced process technology marketplace' where it competes for these capabilities, while Qualcomm states it expects these process technology transitions to 'continue to drive product cost increases from certain of our key semiconductor wafer suppliers,' reflecting the same supply-side cost dynamics in the advanced manufacturing ecosystem.

sentences.text: We compete with TSMC and Samsung in the advanced process technology marketplace.
